training.CV_large_error_group: after completed training only: stored analytical per-target CV ADE>=1.0m; analysis only, never input/gate/checkpoint selection
training.anchor_rule: per recording choose lowest best-ADE neural candidate, deterministic order neural_ego_runs breaks ties; if analytical CV ADE<=best neural ADE, use CV prediction with that neural encoder/head frozen; otherwise use selected neural output; same checkpoint/output rule for every residual control
training.base_stability_rule: all4 neural runs per recording complete30 epochs with finite loss/gradients/metrics and all structural tests pass; nonfinite failure stops residual training; analytical CV remains eligible anchor when it beats neural candidates
training.best_rule: minimum own-recording validation ADE; earliest exact tie; paired FDE; last30 also retained
training.branch_initialization: same seed, last correction layer zero, one scalar gate logit=-2
training.endpoint: seed17 two recordings:8 ego neural runs +4 residual trained branches per recording if finite stability passes; conditional stability only under frozen round3 rule; no extension or architecture/LR search

graph.eligibility: both endpoints two consecutive historical observations
graph.weights: uniform incoming neighbors, uniform mean over frames with messages; target gap resets pooled history

training.loss: unchanged masked per-track mean Euclidean L2; complete targets have12 points
training.random_rule: retrain branch with coordinate/time-hash ranked same-frame/same-batch/radius4/continuous/no-self candidates; match real incoming budget except entire hash ties; report actual changed fraction and distance/budget shift; weak swapping cannot establish no relational value
training.round3_rule: a true social variant must beat both its own frozen Ego-Only and matched Ego-Residual by at least max(.005m,.005*reference_ADE) in BOTH recordings and not worsen pairedFDE against either; only then run42/2026, freeze per-recording anchor model/schedule/output family selected at17 and train it from scratch for each seed, then all4 residual controls with same seed-specific anchor; no seed replacement
